voice.name: Nugget + Sprocket
voice.model: Nugget's lines from the eleven_v3 recordings short05_vo_nugget_01/02 (the voice-changed 'everything' came out as 'eeverything'), Sprocket's 'Wrench, please' from short05_vo_sprocket_01, his 'Close' from Veo's own take re-voiced with eleven_multilingual_sts_v2; all placed on the mouths

signoff.note: audio/signoffs/signoff_nugget.mp3 at 1.15x, on Nugget's beak 0.6-2.4s into the tail

video.description: SPROCKET (refs/characters/sprocket_noprop_ref.png) beside the workbench, NUGGET hero form (refs/characters/nugget_hero_ref.png) standing on it; the wrench and the carrot lie on the bench from the first frame. One continuous two-shot, both speaking on camera.

shots.note: Nugget's beak moves 0.3-1.1 ('I'm Nugget!'); in the clip Sprocket's mouth moves 1.5-2.9 while Veo's audio has Nugget talking, so 1.1-2.8 is replaced by the insert
4s insert from the main clip's frames at 1.1s (start) and 2.8s (end); Nugget says 'I help with EVERYTHING!' 0.3-1.9 with Sprocket's mouth closed; cut at 1.95, before Sprocket starts talking

back to the main clip at 2.8 (dissolve): Sprocket 'Wrench, please' 2.9-3.5, Nugget hands over the carrot and says 'Wrench!' 3.8-4.5, Sprocket looks down at it ~4.7, 'Close' 6.0-6.8; cut at 7.5 (both eyes open). The first attempt (Veo gave Sprocket's line to Nugget) is in archive/shorts/short05/v2_lines_swapped/

from the main clip at 7.5s; Nugget cheers 'We can fix anything!' with wings up ~0.6-2.3, one carrot that never moves (the first tail invented a second carrot in Sprocket's free hoof); cut at 2.5 before Nugget's eyes squint shut
